name: Claude Code
notes: claude-agent-sdk with tools off, no MCP servers, no project settings, in an empty folder.

name: Cursor Agent
notes: cursor-agent -p --output-format json --mode ask --sandbox enabled; flags verified with --help. Real call not verified yet: the CLI on the build Mac was not logged in.

name: Codex CLI
auth_hint: Install Codex CLI (`codex` was not found).
notes: codex exec --sandbox read-only --ephemeral, prompt on stdin; from the official CLI reference.

name: Gemini CLI
auth_hint: Install Gemini CLI (`gemini` was not found).
notes: gemini --prompt ... --output-format json --approval-mode default; from the official CLI reference.

name: OpenCode
notes: opencode run --format json --dir <tmp>; models are provider/model. JSON event shape is parsed defensively.

name: Qwen Code
auth_hint: Install Qwen Code (`qwen` was not found).
notes: qwen --prompt ... --output-format json; from the Qwen Code headless docs.

name: GitHub Copilot CLI
auth_hint: Install GitHub Copilot CLI (`copilot` was not found).
notes: copilot -p ... -s --no-ask-user --deny-tool shell --deny-tool write; from GitHub's programmatic reference.

name: Grok CLI
auth_hint: Install Grok CLI (`grok` was not found).
notes: Community grok-cli (superagent-ai), not an official xAI tool: grok --prompt ... --directory <tmp>.

name: Factory Droid
auth_hint: Install Factory Droid (`droid` was not found).
notes: droid exec -o json --cwd <tmp> (read-only without --auto); from the Factory CLI reference.

name: Ollama
auth_hint: Install Ollama from ollama.com, then pull a model.
notes: POST /api/chat with format = the JSON schema.

name: Anthropic API
auth_hint: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (the Mac app stores it in the Keychain).
notes: Messages API, billed per token. haiku/sonnet/opus map to the current model ids.

name: OpenAI API
auth_hint: Set OPENAI_API_KEY (the Mac app stores it in the Keychain).
notes: Chat Completions, billed per token. Default model names are suggestions; pick any your key can use.
